contract_answer.question: Does the s=50 gate reparameterisation confirm on paper split 42 that NA-E006's fixed-blend behaviour was a gate-learning-speed limitation?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from all 600 selected-checkpoint predictions gives MAPE 0.116952, Acc@15 0.700, and RMSE 41.261 cycles versus same-split NA-E007 at 0.181909, 0.450, and 52.300. MAPE improves in every prefix band (0.1909/0.1521/0.1273/0.0914/0.0815 versus 0.2358/0.2013/0.1854/0.1620/0.1651), prediction-to-target spread rises from 0.4846 to 0.6667, and bias improves from -25.92 to -21.72 cycles. Reconstructed directly from the selected checkpoint and locked split-42 validation inputs, mean gate values rise by prefix band from 0.2592 to 0.4599, 0.5063, 0.5602, and 0.6290; effective calibration moves to a=2.5376 and c=-3.8600. Five of six cells improve in MAPE, led by 5-3-37 (-0.1439) and 5-8-32 (-0.1254), while 6-6-26 regresses by 0.0230. This split therefore confirms that the repaired gate learns substantial prefix dependence and improves the matched configuration; split 2024 is still needed for the proposal's three-split promotion rule.

main_symptom: The s=50 repair produces a large same-split gain and an increasingly extrapolation-weighted late-prefix gate, but residual underprediction remains (-21.72 cycles), cell 6-6-26 worsens from 0.1274 to 0.1503 MAPE, and zero-initialized calibration ratios cause scale-sensitive gradient warnings despite finite nonzero gradients and updates.

causes.interpretation: The selected checkpoint directly expresses the intended mechanism: gate means rise from 0.2592 at prefixes 1-10 to 0.6290 at 76-100, while late-band MAPE falls by 0.0806-0.0836 versus NA-E007. The matched headline gain and improvement in five cells support effective step scale as the leading cause, although the result is not uniform across cells.
missing_evidence: Final three-split mean and sample standard deviation versus NA-E006/NA-E007/NA-E008

causes.class: general representation fit or checkpoint variation
causes.interpretation: Longer training or ordinary checkpoint variation can explain some cell-level movement: the selected epoch is 50, validation MAPE rebounds by 0.0082 afterward, and one cell regresses. It is not the leading account of the broad gain because every prefix band and five of six cells improve while the checkpoint independently shows the intended monotone band-level gate pattern.
missing_evidence: A matched rerun variance estimate on split 42
